title: Groups
purpose: Inspect laboratory role groups and the release authority they grant.
summary: Inspect the role groups, how many members each has and whether it grants release authority. Only superusers can open this list.

tasks.title: Check a group's permissions
steps: Select the group's name to open its permissions.

tasks.title: Create a permission group
steps: Select [[Add group]], name it and choose its permissions.

good_to_know: The built-in groups (admin, custodian, analyst, reviewer, approver, project_manager) are the laboratory roles. A new group never becomes a role.
Groups cannot be deleted. Membership is changed on each user, not here.
Grants release authority only takes effect for active internal members.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: The administration site requires an active account with Staff status. User and group pages additionally require Superuser status; a laboratory admin role alone or individual model permissions do not open them. These technical flags do not themselves confer operational roles or report-release authority.

sections.title: Columns and controls
paragraphs: Search matches case-insensitive substrings. Space-separated terms must each match at least one configured field; quote a phrase to match it as one term. The result query includes all matches, not just visible rows. Clearing the search restores the unsearched set while preserving applicable filters.

These are Django administration tables, not operational grids. The server uses 100 records per page, with numbered page links and a total count. Show all appears when the filtered result count is at most 200 and exceeds one page. There is no Rows per page selector or Columns dialog. Linked sortable headings change order; repeated heading clicks change direction or remove that ordering. The sidebar navigation filter only filters module links, not table records.
Initial order is Name ascending. Name and Members are sortable; Grants release authority is not. There are no sidebar filters, row checkboxes or bulk actions.

items.label: Name
items.description: Unique group identity; opens group permissions.

items.label: Members
items.description: Count of assigned users, including inactive members. It is not a member editing control.

items.label: Grants release authority
items.description: True only when the group has accounts authorize_release. Members still need active internal accounts to exercise that permission.

items.label: Add group
items.description: Creates a permission group. Arbitrary new names do not become built-in laboratory roles.

sections.title: Preservation
paragraphs: Built-in admin, custodian, analyst, reviewer, approver and project_manager names are read only when editing existing groups. Other groups can be renamed. Deletion is disabled for all groups, and permission/name changes are audited.
